description: This file defines the interface for managing neighboring access point (AP) harvesting status and parameters, including setting and getting various reporting and polling periods, as well as default values and override time-to-live (TTL). It declares functions related to controlling and retrieving configuration related to neighboring AP scans in a network management context.

methods.name: SetNAPHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for neighboring AP scans (enabled or disabled).

methods.name: GetNAPHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: SetNAPReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting interval (in seconds) for neighbor AP scanning.

methods.name: GetNAPReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting interval for neighbor AP scanning.

methods.name: SetNAPPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling interval (in seconds) for neighbor AP scanning.

methods.name: GetNAPPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling interval for neighbor AP scanning.

methods.name: SetNAPReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting interval for neighbor AP scanning.

methods.name: GetNAPReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default reporting interval for neighbor AP scanning.

methods.name: SetNAPPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling interval for neighbor AP scanning.

methods.name: GetNAPPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default polling interval for neighbor AP scanning.

methods.name: GetNAPOverrideTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout after which the NAP intervals revert to default values.

methods.name: SetNAPOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout period for accelerated NAP scanning.

methods.name: GetNAPOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default timeout for accelerated NAP scans.

methods.name: ValidateNAPPeriod
methods.description: Validates whether the given period value is within the acceptable range.
